notes.zh:
Tactile 0.1 正式发布：
• 支持完整 33 项 120Hz 高精度触控板与妙控鼠标手势
• 支持流光手势绘字轨迹识别
• 国内用户默认通过 Gitee 极速镜像检查更新与下载，海外用户支持 GitHub 官方源
• 关于界面全面展示 Gitee 与 GitHub 双镜像代码及发布仓链接
• 针对 macOS 12 Monterey 至 macOS 15+ 深度适配，超低延迟零异响
notes.en:
Tactile 0.1 Official Release:
• Comprehensive 33 high-precision 120Hz trackpad & Magic Mouse gestures
• Fluid character gesture recognition with glow trails
• Dual-channel fast updates: Gitee default for mainland China, GitHub for global users
• Dual repository & release links for Gitee & GitHub in About view
• Optimized for macOS 12 Monterey through macOS 15+ with zero trackpad rattle

gitee.name: Gitee 码云极速镜像 (国内用户)

github.name: GitHub 官方分发 (海外用户)
